ko.title: 한 명의 판사, 한 번의 번복: 대법원이 투표 시작 며칠 전 트럼프 행정부의 우편 투표 규정을 위한 길을 열어준 방법

segments.src: A federal judge in Boston has undone her own order blocking a Trump administration directive on how mail-in ballots are handled by the U.S.
segments.tr: 보스턴의 한 연방 판사가 트럼프 행정부의 우편 투표 처리 지침을 차단했던 자신의 명령을 스스로 철회했습니다. 이 지침은 미국

segments.src: Postal Service, after the Supreme Court intervened in the case earlier this week.
segments.tr: 우편국(Postal Service)에 관한 것으로, 이번 주 초 대법원이 해당 사건에 개입한 이후 이루어진 조치입니다.

segments.src: The reversal removes, at least for now, a legal obstacle standing between the administration's policy and the first wave of mail ballots set to go out for this year's midterm elections.
segments.tr: 이번 번복으로 행정부의 정책과 올해 중간선거를 위해 발송될 첫 우편 투표 물결 사이에 놓여 있던 법적 장애물이 적어도 당분간은 제거되었습니다.

segments.src: ## What the Original Order Required
segments.tr: ## 원래 명령의 요구 사항

segments.src: According to court filings, the directive at the center of the dispute instructs the Postal Service to apply barcoded tracking to mail-ballot envelopes and to share certain voter-list information with federal authorities as part of an effort the administration has described as strengthening the security and traceability of mail voting.
segments.tr: 법원 문서에 따르면, 이번 분쟁의 핵심인 지침은 우편국이 우편 투표 봉투에 바코드 추적을 적용하고, 행정부가 우편 투표의 보안 및 추적 가능성을 강화하기 위한 노력의 일환으로 설명한 조치로서 특정 유권자 명부 정보를 연방 당국과 공유하도록 지시하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Administration officials have said the measures are intended to reduce processing errors and give election offices a clearer chain of custody for ballots moving through the mail system.
segments.tr: 행정부 관계자들은 이러한 조치가 처리 오류를 줄이고 선거 사무소에 우편 시스템을 통해 이동하는 투표용지에 대한 더 명확한 관리 체계를 제공하기 위한 것이라고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Voting rights groups and several state election officials sued to block the policy soon after it was announced, arguing it was rolled out without the standard rulemaking process and could create confusion or delays for voters relying on mail ballots.
segments.tr: 투표권 단체들과 여러 주 선거 관리들은 이 정책이 발표된 직후 표준적인 규칙 제정 절차 없이 시행되었으며 우편 투표에 의존하는 유권자들에게 혼란이나 지연을 초래할 수 있다고 주장하며 소송을 제기했습니다.

segments.src: The Boston-based judge sided with the challengers earlier this year and issued a nationwide injunction pausing the directive while the case proceeded.
segments.tr: 보스턴에 소재한 해당 판사는 올해 초 원고 측의 손을 들어주었으며, 소송이 진행되는 동안 해당 지침을 일시 중지하는 전국적인 금지 명령을 내렸습니다.

segments.src: ## The Supreme Court's Role
segments.tr: ## 대법원의 역할

segments.src: The administration appealed, and the case moved through the courts on an emergency basis.
segments.tr: 행정부는 항소했고, 사건은 긴급 절차에 따라 법원을 거쳐 진행되었습니다.

segments.src: Earlier this week, the Supreme Court issued an order in the case that, according to legal analysts tracking the litigation, effectively required the lower court to lift its injunction while the underlying legal questions continue to be litigated.
segments.tr: 이번 주 초, 대법원은 소송을 추적하는 법률 분석가들에 따르면 하급 법원이 근본적인 법적 문제가 계속 다투어지는 동안 금지 명령을 해제하도록 사실상 요구하는 명령을 내렸습니다.

segments.src: The justices did not rule on the merits of the policy itself; the order addressed only whether the injunction should remain in place during the appeal.
segments.tr: 대법관들은 정책 자체의 타당성에 대해서는 판결하지 않았으며, 이번 명령은 항소 기간 동안 금지 명령이 유지되어야 하는지에 대해서만 다루었습니다.

segments.src: Following that order, the district judge in Boston formally vacated her own injunction, writing that she was bound by the higher court's directive even as she noted the underlying legal challenge remains active.
segments.tr: 해당 명령에 따라 보스턴의 지방 판사는 근본적인 법적 도전이 여전히 유효하다는 점을 언급하면서도 상급 법원의 지침에 구속된다고 적으며 자신의 금지 명령을 공식적으로 취소했습니다.

segments.src: Legal experts caution that this procedural sequence is common in emergency litigation and does not amount to a final judgment on whether the policy is lawful.
segments.tr: 법률 전문가들은 이러한 절차적 순서가 긴급 소송에서는 흔한 일이며 정책이 합법적인지에 대한 최종 판결을 의미하는 것은 아니라고 경고합니다.

segments.src: ## Practical Effect Ahead of the Midterms
segments.tr: ## 중간선거를 앞둔 실질적인 영향

segments.src: With the injunction lifted, the Postal Service and participating election offices are expected to move forward with barcoded ballot-envelope tracking and the data-sharing arrangements described in the directive, according to officials familiar with the rollout.
segments.tr: 금지 명령이 해제됨에 따라 우편국과 참여 선거 사무소는 바코드 투표 봉투 추적 및 지침에 설명된 데이터 공유 합의를 진행할 것으로 예상된다고 이 사안에 정통한 관계자들이 전했습니다.

segments.src: Because mail ballots for several midterm contests are scheduled to begin going out in the coming days, the timing has drawn significant attention from election administrators trying to determine how the change affects existing procedures.
segments.tr: 여러 중간선거를 위한 우편 투표용지가 며칠 내로 발송될 예정이기 때문에, 이러한 변화가 기존 절차에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 파악하려는 선거 관리자들 사이에서 이 시점은 상당한 주목을 받고 있습니다.

segments.src: Some state election officials have said they are still reviewing guidance from the Postal Service on implementation and have asked for clarity on timelines.
segments.tr: 일부 주 선거 관리들은 여전히 우편국의 이행 지침을 검토 중이며 일정에 대한 명확한 설명을 요청했다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Voting rights organizations that brought the original suit said they plan to continue pressing their case in the lower courts, arguing that questions about the policy's legal basis and its effect on voters remain unresolved.
segments.tr: 원래 소송을 제기했던 투표권 단체들은 정책의 법적 근거와 유권자에게 미치는 영향에 대한 의문이 해결되지 않았다고 주장하며 하급 법원에서 소송을 계속 진행할 계획이라고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: ## Reactions Remain Divided
segments.tr: ## 여전히 엇갈리는 반응

segments.src: Administration officials welcomed the Supreme Court's order, framing it as validation of the government's authority to set mail-handling standards for ballots in coordination with the Postal Service.
segments.tr: 행정부 관계자들은 대법원의 명령을 환영하며, 이를 우편국과 협력하여 투표용지에 대한 우편 처리 기준을 설정할 정부 권한에 대한 검증으로 규정했습니다.

segments.src: Critics of the policy, including several election law scholars, have said the fight is far from over and that the Supreme Court's action was procedural rather than a ruling on the policy's merits.
segments.tr: 여러 선거법 학자를 포함한 정책 비판자들은 싸움이 아직 끝나지 않았으며 대법원의 조치는 정책의 타당성에 대한 판결이 아니라 절차적인 것이었다고 말했습니다.

segments.src: Election administrators in multiple states, meanwhile, have generally struck a more cautious tone, emphasizing that their priority is ensuring voters are not confused or disenfranchised by any last-minute operational changes.
segments.tr: 한편, 여러 주의 선거 관리들은 일반적으로 더 신중한 태도를 보이며, 유권자들이 막판 운영 변경으로 인해 혼란을 겪거나 투표권을 박탈당하지 않도록 하는 것이 최우선 과제임을 강조했습니다.

segments.src: Several have called for clear, timely communication from federal agencies as ballots begin to move through the mail.
segments.tr: 일부 관리들은 투표용지가 우편을 통해 이동하기 시작함에 따라 연방 기관으로부터 명확하고 시기적절한 소통이 이루어져야 한다고 촉구했습니다.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 다음 단계

segments.src: The underlying lawsuit challenging the mail-ballot directive continues in the lower courts, and further rulings are expected in the coming months.
segments.tr: 우편 투표 지침에 이의를 제기하는 본안 소송은 하급 법원에서 계속 진행 중이며, 향후 몇 달 내에 추가 판결이 나올 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: In the meantime, election officials and voters in affected jurisdictions are being advised to watch for updated guidance from their local election offices and the Postal Service as mail ballots begin going out for the midterm cycle.
segments.tr: 그동안 영향을 받는 관할 구역의 선거 관리들과 유권자들은 중간선거 주기를 위해 우편 투표용지가 발송되기 시작함에 따라 지역 선거 사무소와 우편국에서 제공하는 업데이트된 지침을 주시하라는 조언을 받고 있습니다.

segments.src: As with any active litigation, the legal landscape here could shift again before Election Day, and readers should look to official state election websites and verified USPS communications for the most current, ballot-specific instructions.
segments.tr: 진행 중인 모든 소송과 마찬가지로, 이곳의 법적 상황은 선거일 전에 다시 바뀔 수 있으므로 독자들은 가장 최신의 투표 관련 지침을 확인하기 위해 공식 주 선거 웹사이트와 검증된 USPS 통신을 참조해야 합니다.

zh.title: 一名法官，一次逆转：最高法院如何在投票开始前几天为特朗普政府的邮寄选票规则扫清道路

segments.src: A federal judge in Boston has undone her own order blocking a Trump administration directive on how mail-in ballots are handled by the U.S.
segments.tr: 波士顿的一名联邦法官撤销了她自己阻止特朗普政府关于如何处理美国邮政局邮件的指令的命令，

segments.src: Postal Service, after the Supreme Court intervened in the case earlier this week.
segments.tr: 此前最高法院本周早些时候介入了此案。

segments.src: The reversal removes, at least for now, a legal obstacle standing between the administration's policy and the first wave of mail ballots set to go out for this year's midterm elections.
segments.tr: 这一逆转至少目前扫除了阻碍行政当局政策与今年中期选举第一波发出的邮寄选票之间的一道法律障碍。

segments.src: ## What the Original Order Required
segments.tr: ## 原指令的要求

segments.src: According to court filings, the directive at the center of the dispute instructs the Postal Service to apply barcoded tracking to mail-ballot envelopes and to share certain voter-list information with federal authorities as part of an effort the administration has described as strengthening the security and traceability of mail voting.
segments.tr: 根据法庭文件，处于争议中心的指令指示邮政局对邮寄选票信封应用条形码追踪，并与联邦当局分享某些选民名单信息，作为行政当局所描述的旨在加强邮寄投票安全性和可追溯性努力的一部分。

segments.src: Administration officials have said the measures are intended to reduce processing errors and give election offices a clearer chain of custody for ballots moving through the mail system.
segments.tr: 行政官员表示，这些措施旨在减少处理错误，并为在邮件系统中流转的选票提供更清晰的监管链。

segments.src: Voting rights groups and several state election officials sued to block the policy soon after it was announced, arguing it was rolled out without the standard rulemaking process and could create confusion or delays for voters relying on mail ballots.
segments.tr: 投票权组织和几位州选举官员在该政策宣布后不久起诉阻止该政策，辩称其在没有经过标准规则制定程序的情况下出台，可能会给依赖邮寄选票的选民造成困惑或延误。

segments.src: The Boston-based judge sided with the challengers earlier this year and issued a nationwide injunction pausing the directive while the case proceeded.
segments.tr: 这位驻波士顿的法官今年早些时候站在了原告一边，并发布了全国范围的禁令，在案件审理期间暂停该指令。

segments.src: ## The Supreme Court's Role
segments.tr: ## 最高法院的角色

segments.src: The administration appealed, and the case moved through the courts on an emergency basis.
segments.tr: 行政当局提出了上诉，该案以紧急程序在法院审理。

segments.src: Earlier this week, the Supreme Court issued an order in the case that, according to legal analysts tracking the litigation, effectively required the lower court to lift its injunction while the underlying legal questions continue to be litigated.
segments.tr: 本周早些时候，最高法院在该案中发布了一项命令，跟踪诉讼的法律分析人士称，该命令实际上要求下级法院在继续审理潜在法律问题的同时解除其禁令。

segments.src: The justices did not rule on the merits of the policy itself; the order addressed only whether the injunction should remain in place during the appeal.
segments.tr: 大法官们并未对该政策本身的实质内容做出裁决；该命令仅涉及在上诉期间是否应维持禁令。

segments.src: Following that order, the district judge in Boston formally vacated her own injunction, writing that she was bound by the higher court's directive even as she noted the underlying legal challenge remains active.
segments.tr: 在该命令之后，波士顿的地方法官正式撤销了她自己的禁令，写道她受制于上级法院的指令，尽管她指出潜在的法律挑战仍然活跃。

segments.src: Legal experts caution that this procedural sequence is common in emergency litigation and does not amount to a final judgment on whether the policy is lawful.
segments.tr: 法律专家警告说，这种诉讼程序顺序在紧急诉讼中很常见，并不等同于关于该政策是否合法的最终判决。

segments.src: ## Practical Effect Ahead of the Midterms
segments.tr: ## 中期选举前的实际影响

segments.src: With the injunction lifted, the Postal Service and participating election offices are expected to move forward with barcoded ballot-envelope tracking and the data-sharing arrangements described in the directive, according to officials familiar with the rollout.
segments.tr: 据熟悉发布情况的官员称，随着禁令的解除，邮政局和参与的选举机构预计将推进条形码选票信封追踪以及指令中所述的数据共享安排。

segments.src: Because mail ballots for several midterm contests are scheduled to begin going out in the coming days, the timing has drawn significant attention from election administrators trying to determine how the change affects existing procedures.
segments.tr: 由于几个中期选举的邮寄选票计划在未来几天开始发出，这一时机引起了试图确定该变化如何影响现有程序的选举管理人员的极大关注。

segments.src: Some state election officials have said they are still reviewing guidance from the Postal Service on implementation and have asked for clarity on timelines.
segments.tr: 一些州选举官员表示，他们仍在审查邮政局关于实施的指导意见，并要求明确时间表。

segments.src: Voting rights organizations that brought the original suit said they plan to continue pressing their case in the lower courts, arguing that questions about the policy's legal basis and its effect on voters remain unresolved.
segments.tr: 提起最初诉讼的投票权组织表示，他们计划继续在下级法院推进其案件，辩称关于该政策法律基础及其对选民影响的问题仍未解决。

segments.src: ## Reactions Remain Divided
segments.tr: ## 反应仍然存在分歧

segments.src: Administration officials welcomed the Supreme Court's order, framing it as validation of the government's authority to set mail-handling standards for ballots in coordination with the Postal Service.
segments.tr: 行政官员对最高法院的命令表示欢迎，将其视为对政府与邮政局协调制定选票邮件处理标准权力的确认。

segments.src: Critics of the policy, including several election law scholars, have said the fight is far from over and that the Supreme Court's action was procedural rather than a ruling on the policy's merits.
segments.tr: 该政策的批评者，包括几位选举法学者，表示斗争远未结束，最高法院的行动是程序性的，而不是对政策实质的裁决。

segments.src: Election administrators in multiple states, meanwhile, have generally struck a more cautious tone, emphasizing that their priority is ensuring voters are not confused or disenfranchised by any last-minute operational changes.
segments.tr: 与此同时，多州的选举管理者总体上采取了更为谨慎的基调，强调他们的首要任务是确保选民不会因任何最后一刻的操作变化而感到困惑或剥夺投票权。

segments.src: Several have called for clear, timely communication from federal agencies as ballots begin to move through the mail.
segments.tr: 几个人呼吁联邦机构在选票开始通过邮件传送时进行清晰、及时的沟通。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: The underlying lawsuit challenging the mail-ballot directive continues in the lower courts, and further rulings are expected in the coming months.
segments.tr: 对挑战邮寄选票指令的基础诉讼仍在下级法院继续，预计在未来几个月会有进一步的裁决。

segments.src: In the meantime, election officials and voters in affected jurisdictions are being advised to watch for updated guidance from their local election offices and the Postal Service as mail ballots begin going out for the midterm cycle.
segments.tr: 与此同时，建议受影响管辖区的选举官员和选民密切关注当地选举办公室和邮政局的更新指导意见，因为中期选举周期的邮寄选票开始发出。

segments.src: As with any active litigation, the legal landscape here could shift again before Election Day, and readers should look to official state election websites and verified USPS communications for the most current, ballot-specific instructions.
segments.tr: 与任何活跃的诉讼一样，这里的法律环境在选举日之前可能会再次发生变化，读者应参考官方州选举网站和经过验证的USPS通信，以获取最新、最具体的选票说明。

segments.tr: डाक सेवा (Postal Service) द्वारा कैसे संभाला जाए, इस सप्ताह की शुरुआत में सुप्रीम कोर्ट के मामले में हस्तक्षेप करने के बाद।

segments.src: The reversal removes, at least for now, a legal obstacle standing between the administration's policy and the first wave of mail ballots set to go out for this year's midterm elections.
segments.tr: यह उलटफेर, कम से कम अभी के लिए, प्रशासन की नीति और इस साल के मध्यावधि चुनावों के लिए भेजे जाने वाले मेल मतपत्रों की पहली लहर के बीच खड़ी एक कानूनी बाधा को हटा देता है।

segments.src: ## What the Original Order Required
segments.tr: ## मूल आदेश में क्या आवश्यक था

segments.src: According to court filings, the directive at the center of the dispute instructs the Postal Service to apply barcoded tracking to mail-ballot envelopes and to share certain voter-list information with federal authorities as part of an effort the administration has described as strengthening the security and traceability of mail voting.
segments.tr: अदालती दस्तावेजों के अनुसार, विवाद के केंद्र में मौजूद निर्देश डाक सेवा को मेल-बैलेट लिफाफों पर बारकोड ट्रैकिंग लागू करने और संघीय अधिकारियों के साथ कुछ मतदाता-सूची जानकारी साझा करने का निर्देश देता है, जो उस प्रयास का हिस्सा है जिसे प्रशासन ने मेल वोटिंग की सुरक्षा और पता लगाने की क्षमता को मजबूत करने के रूप में वर्णित किया है।

segments.src: Administration officials have said the measures are intended to reduce processing errors and give election offices a clearer chain of custody for ballots moving through the mail system.
segments.tr: प्रशासन के अधिकारियों ने कहा है कि इन उपायों का उद्देश्य प्रसंस्करण त्रुटियों को कम करना और चुनाव कार्यालयों को डाक प्रणाली के माध्यम से जाने वाले मतपत्रों के लिए कस्टडी की एक स्पष्ट श्रृंखला प्रदान करना है।

segments.src: Voting rights groups and several state election officials sued to block the policy soon after it was announced, arguing it was rolled out without the standard rulemaking process and could create confusion or delays for voters relying on mail ballots.
segments.tr: मतदान अधिकार समूहों और कई राज्य चुनाव अधिकारियों ने नीति की घोषणा के तुरंत बाद इसे रोकने के लिए मुकदमा दायर किया, यह तर्क देते हुए कि इसे मानक नियम-निर्माण प्रक्रिया के बिना शुरू किया गया था और यह मेल मतपत्रों पर निर्भर मतदाताओं के लिए भ्रम या देरी पैदा कर सकता है।

segments.src: The Boston-based judge sided with the challengers earlier this year and issued a nationwide injunction pausing the directive while the case proceeded.
segments.tr: बोस्टन स्थित न्यायाधीश ने इस साल की शुरुआत में चुनौती देने वालों का पक्ष लिया और मामले की सुनवाई के दौरान निर्देश को रोकने के लिए राष्ट्रव्यापी निषेधाज्ञा (injunction) जारी की।

segments.src: ## The Supreme Court's Role
segments.tr: ## सुप्रीम कोर्ट की भूमिका

segments.src: The administration appealed, and the case moved through the courts on an emergency basis.
segments.tr: प्रशासन ने अपील की, और मामला आपातकालीन आधार पर अदालतों में चला।

segments.src: Earlier this week, the Supreme Court issued an order in the case that, according to legal analysts tracking the litigation, effectively required the lower court to lift its injunction while the underlying legal questions continue to be litigated.
segments.tr: इस सप्ताह की शुरुआत में, सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने मामले में एक आदेश जारी किया, जो मुकदमेबाजी पर नज़र रखने वाले कानूनी विश्लेषकों के अनुसार, प्रभावी रूप से निचली अदालत को अपनी निषेधाज्ञा हटाने के लिए आवश्यक बनाता है, जबकि अंतर्निहित कानूनी सवालों पर मुकदमेबाजी जारी है।

segments.src: The justices did not rule on the merits of the policy itself; the order addressed only whether the injunction should remain in place during the appeal.
segments.tr: न्यायाधीशों ने नीति के गुणों पर कोई फैसला नहीं सुनाया; आदेश ने केवल इस बात को संबोधित किया कि क्या अपील के दौरान निषेधाज्ञा लागू रहनी चाहिए।

segments.src: Following that order, the district judge in Boston formally vacated her own injunction, writing that she was bound by the higher court's directive even as she noted the underlying legal challenge remains active.
segments.tr: उस आदेश के बाद, बोस्टन में जिला न्यायाधीश ने औपचारिक रूप से अपनी निषेधाज्ञा को रद्द कर दिया, यह लिखते हुए कि वह उच्च न्यायालय के निर्देश से बंधी हुई हैं, भले ही उन्होंने उल्लेख किया कि अंतर्निहित कानूनी चुनौती अभी भी सक्रिय है।

segments.src: Legal experts caution that this procedural sequence is common in emergency litigation and does not amount to a final judgment on whether the policy is lawful.
segments.tr: कानूनी विशेषज्ञ चेतावनी देते हैं कि यह प्रक्रियात्मक क्रम आपातकालीन मुकदमेबाजी में सामान्य है और यह इस बात पर अंतिम निर्णय नहीं है कि नीति वैध है या नहीं।

segments.src: ## Practical Effect Ahead of the Midterms
segments.tr: ## मध्यावधि चुनावों से पहले व्यावहारिक प्रभाव

segments.src: With the injunction lifted, the Postal Service and participating election offices are expected to move forward with barcoded ballot-envelope tracking and the data-sharing arrangements described in the directive, according to officials familiar with the rollout.
segments.tr: निषेधाज्ञा हटने के साथ, डाक सेवा और भाग लेने वाले चुनाव कार्यालयों से उम्मीद की जाती है कि वे बारकोड वाले मतपत्र-लिफाफा ट्रैकिंग और निर्देश में वर्णित डेटा-साझाकरण व्यवस्था के साथ आगे बढ़ेंगे, रोलआउट से परिचित अधिकारियों के अनुसार।

segments.src: Because mail ballots for several midterm contests are scheduled to begin going out in the coming days, the timing has drawn significant attention from election administrators trying to determine how the change affects existing procedures.
segments.tr: चूंकि कई मध्यावधि चुनावों के लिए मेल मतपत्र आने वाले दिनों में भेजे जाने वाले हैं, इसलिए समय ने उन चुनाव प्रशासकों का ध्यान आकर्षित किया है जो यह निर्धारित करने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं कि यह बदलाव मौजूदा प्रक्रियाओं को कैसे प्रभावित करता है।

segments.src: Some state election officials have said they are still reviewing guidance from the Postal Service on implementation and have asked for clarity on timelines.
segments.tr: कुछ राज्य चुनाव अधिकारियों ने कहा है कि वे अभी भी कार्यान्वयन पर डाक सेवा से मार्गदर्शन की समीक्षा कर रहे हैं और उन्होंने समयसीमा पर स्पष्टता मांगी है।

segments.src: Voting rights organizations that brought the original suit said they plan to continue pressing their case in the lower courts, arguing that questions about the policy's legal basis and its effect on voters remain unresolved.
segments.tr: मूल मुकदमा लाने वाले मतदान अधिकार संगठनों ने कहा कि वे निचली अदालतों में अपना मामला जारी रखने की योजना बना रहे हैं, यह तर्क देते हुए कि नीति के कानूनी आधार और मतदाताओं पर इसके प्रभाव के बारे में सवाल अनसुलझे हैं।

segments.src: ## Reactions Remain Divided
segments.tr: ## प्रतिक्रियाएं विभाजित हैं

segments.src: Administration officials welcomed the Supreme Court's order, framing it as validation of the government's authority to set mail-handling standards for ballots in coordination with the Postal Service.
segments.tr: प्रशासन के अधिकारियों ने सुप्रीम कोर्ट के आदेश का स्वागत किया, इसे डाक सेवा के समन्वय में मतपत्रों के लिए मेल-हैंडलिंग मानक निर्धारित करने के सरकार के अधिकार की पुष्टि के रूप में तैयार किया।

segments.src: Critics of the policy, including several election law scholars, have said the fight is far from over and that the Supreme Court's action was procedural rather than a ruling on the policy's merits.
segments.tr: नीति के आलोचकों, जिनमें कई चुनाव कानून विद्वान शामिल हैं, ने कहा है कि लड़ाई अभी खत्म नहीं हुई है और सुप्रीम कोर्ट की कार्रवाई नीति के गुणों पर फैसले के बजाय प्रक्रियात्मक थी।

segments.src: Election administrators in multiple states, meanwhile, have generally struck a more cautious tone, emphasizing that their priority is ensuring voters are not confused or disenfranchised by any last-minute operational changes.
segments.tr: इस बीच, कई राज्यों में चुनाव प्रशासकों ने आम तौर पर अधिक सतर्क रुख अपनाया है, इस बात पर जोर देते हुए कि उनकी प्राथमिकता यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि मतदाता किसी भी अंतिम समय के परिचालन परिवर्तनों से भ्रमित या वंचित न हों।

segments.src: Several have called for clear, timely communication from federal agencies as ballots begin to move through the mail.
segments.tr: कई लोगों ने संघीय एजेंसियों से स्पष्ट, समय पर संचार का आह्वान किया है क्योंकि मतपत्र डाक के माध्यम से जाने लगे हैं।

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होता है

segments.src: The underlying lawsuit challenging the mail-ballot directive continues in the lower courts, and further rulings are expected in the coming months.
segments.tr: मेल-बैलेट निर्देश को चुनौती देने वाला अंतर्निहित मुकदमा निचली अदालतों में जारी है, और आने वाले महीनों में और फैसलों की उम्मीद है।

segments.src: In the meantime, election officials and voters in affected jurisdictions are being advised to watch for updated guidance from their local election offices and the Postal Service as mail ballots begin going out for the midterm cycle.
segments.tr: इस बीच, प्रभावित क्षेत्राधिकारों में चुनाव अधिकारियों और मतदाताओं को सलाह दी जा रही है कि वे अपने स्थानीय चुनाव कार्यालयों और डाक सेवा से अपडेटेड मार्गदर्शन पर नज़र रखें क्योंकि मध्यावधि चक्र के लिए मेल मतपत्र भेजे जाने लगे हैं।

segments.src: As with any active litigation, the legal landscape here could shift again before Election Day, and readers should look to official state election websites and verified USPS communications for the most current, ballot-specific instructions.
segments.tr: किसी भी सक्रिय मुकदमेबाजी की तरह, यहां कानूनी परिदृश्य चुनाव के दिन से पहले फिर से बदल सकता है, और पाठकों को सबसे वर्तमान, मतपत्र-विशिष्ट निर्देशों के लिए आधिकारिक राज्य चुनाव वेबसाइटों और सत्यापित USPS संचारों को देखना चाहिए।

es.title: Un juez, una revocación: cómo la Corte Suprema despejó el camino para la regla de voto por correo de la administración Trump días antes de que comience la votación

segments.src: A federal judge in Boston has undone her own order blocking a Trump administration directive on how mail-in ballots are handled by the U.S.
segments.tr: Una jueza federal de Boston ha anulado su propia orden que bloqueaba una directiva de la administración Trump sobre cómo el Servicio Postal de EE. UU. gestiona las papeletas de voto por correo,

segments.src: Postal Service, after the Supreme Court intervened in the case earlier this week.
segments.tr: después de que la Corte Suprema interviniera en el caso a principios de esta semana.

segments.src: The reversal removes, at least for now, a legal obstacle standing between the administration's policy and the first wave of mail ballots set to go out for this year's midterm elections.
segments.tr: La revocación elimina, al menos por ahora, un obstáculo legal entre la política de la administración y la primera ola de papeletas por correo que se enviarán para las elecciones de mitad de mandato de este año.

segments.src: ## What the Original Order Required
segments.tr: ## Lo que exigía la orden original

segments.src: According to court filings, the directive at the center of the dispute instructs the Postal Service to apply barcoded tracking to mail-ballot envelopes and to share certain voter-list information with federal authorities as part of an effort the administration has described as strengthening the security and traceability of mail voting.
segments.tr: Según los documentos judiciales, la directiva en el centro de la disputa instruye al Servicio Postal a aplicar el seguimiento por código de barras a los sobres de las papeletas por correo y a compartir cierta información de las listas de votantes con las autoridades federales como parte de un esfuerzo que la administración ha descrito como un fortalecimiento de la seguridad y el rastreo del voto por correo.

segments.src: Administration officials have said the measures are intended to reduce processing errors and give election offices a clearer chain of custody for ballots moving through the mail system.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de la administración han dicho que las medidas tienen como objetivo reducir los errores de procesamiento y dar a las oficinas electorales una cadena de custodia más clara para las papeletas que se desplazan a través del sistema postal.

segments.src: Voting rights groups and several state election officials sued to block the policy soon after it was announced, arguing it was rolled out without the standard rulemaking process and could create confusion or delays for voters relying on mail ballots.
segments.tr: Los grupos de derechos de voto y varios funcionarios electorales estatales demandaron para bloquear la política poco después de que fuera anunciada, argumentando que se implementó sin el proceso estándar de reglamentación y que podría crear confusión o retrasos para los votantes que dependen de las papeletas por correo.

segments.src: The Boston-based judge sided with the challengers earlier this year and issued a nationwide injunction pausing the directive while the case proceeded.
segments.tr: La jueza con sede en Boston se puso del lado de los demandantes a principios de este año e emitió un mandato judicial a nivel nacional que pausaba la directiva mientras el caso avanzaba.

segments.src: ## The Supreme Court's Role
segments.tr: ## El papel de la Corte Suprema

segments.src: The administration appealed, and the case moved through the courts on an emergency basis.
segments.tr: La administración apeló y el caso avanzó a través de los tribunales de manera urgente.

segments.src: Earlier this week, the Supreme Court issued an order in the case that, according to legal analysts tracking the litigation, effectively required the lower court to lift its injunction while the underlying legal questions continue to be litigated.
segments.tr: A principios de esta semana, la Corte Suprema emitió una orden en el caso que, según los analistas legales que siguen el litigio, requería efectivamente que el tribunal inferior levantara su mandato judicial mientras las cuestiones legales de fondo se siguen litigando.

segments.src: The justices did not rule on the merits of the policy itself; the order addressed only whether the injunction should remain in place during the appeal.
segments.tr: Los magistrados no se pronunciaron sobre el fondo de la política en sí; la orden abordó únicamente si el mandato judicial debía mantenerse durante la apelación.

segments.src: Following that order, the district judge in Boston formally vacated her own injunction, writing that she was bound by the higher court's directive even as she noted the underlying legal challenge remains active.
segments.tr: Tras esa orden, la jueza de distrito de Boston anuló formalmente su propio mandato judicial, escribiendo que estaba vinculada por la directiva del tribunal superior, aunque señaló que el desafío legal subyacente sigue activo.

segments.src: Legal experts caution that this procedural sequence is common in emergency litigation and does not amount to a final judgment on whether the policy is lawful.
segments.tr: Los expertos legales advierten que esta secuencia de procedimiento es común en los litigios de emergencia y no equivale a un fallo definitivo sobre si la política es legal.

segments.src: ## Practical Effect Ahead of the Midterms
segments.tr: ## Efecto práctico antes de las elecciones de mitad de mandato

segments.src: With the injunction lifted, the Postal Service and participating election offices are expected to move forward with barcoded ballot-envelope tracking and the data-sharing arrangements described in the directive, according to officials familiar with the rollout.
segments.tr: Con el mandato judicial levantado, se espera que el Servicio Postal y las oficinas electorales participantes avancen con el seguimiento de sobres de papeletas por código de barras y los acuerdos de intercambio de datos descritos en la directiva, según funcionarios familiarizados con la puesta en marcha.

segments.src: Because mail ballots for several midterm contests are scheduled to begin going out in the coming days, the timing has drawn significant attention from election administrators trying to determine how the change affects existing procedures.
segments.tr: Dado que está programado que las papeletas por correo para varias contiendas de mitad de mandato comiencen a enviarse en los próximos días, la oportunidad ha atraído una atención significativa de los administradores electorales que intentan determinar cómo afecta el cambio a los procedimientos existentes.

segments.src: Some state election officials have said they are still reviewing guidance from the Postal Service on implementation and have asked for clarity on timelines.
segments.tr: Algunos funcionarios electorales estatales han dicho que todavía están revisando la guía del Servicio Postal sobre la implementación y han pedido claridad sobre los plazos.

segments.src: Voting rights organizations that brought the original suit said they plan to continue pressing their case in the lower courts, arguing that questions about the policy's legal basis and its effect on voters remain unresolved.
segments.tr: Las organizaciones de derechos de voto que presentaron la demanda original dijeron que planean continuar presionando con su caso en los tribunales inferiores, argumentando que las preguntas sobre la base legal de la política y su efecto en los votantes siguen sin resolverse.

segments.src: ## Reactions Remain Divided
segments.tr: ## Las reacciones siguen divididas

segments.src: Administration officials welcomed the Supreme Court's order, framing it as validation of the government's authority to set mail-handling standards for ballots in coordination with the Postal Service.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de la administración acogieron con satisfacción la orden de la Corte Suprema, enmarcándola como una validación de la autoridad del gobierno para establecer estándares de manejo de correo para las papeletas en coordinación con el Servicio Postal.

segments.src: Critics of the policy, including several election law scholars, have said the fight is far from over and that the Supreme Court's action was procedural rather than a ruling on the policy's merits.
segments.tr: Los críticos de la política, incluidos varios académicos de derecho electoral, han dicho que la lucha está lejos de terminar y que la acción de la Corte Suprema fue de procedimiento más que un fallo sobre el fondo de la política.

segments.src: Election administrators in multiple states, meanwhile, have generally struck a more cautious tone, emphasizing that their priority is ensuring voters are not confused or disenfranchised by any last-minute operational changes.
segments.tr: Mientras tanto, los administradores electorales en múltiples estados generalmente han adoptado un tono más cauteloso, enfatizando que su prioridad es garantizar que los votantes no se confundan ni sean privados de sus derechos por ningún cambio operativo de última hora.

segments.src: Several have called for clear, timely communication from federal agencies as ballots begin to move through the mail.
segments.tr: Varios han pedido una comunicación clara y oportuna por parte de las agencias federales a medida que las papeletas comienzan a circular por el correo.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sucede a continuación

segments.src: The underlying lawsuit challenging the mail-ballot directive continues in the lower courts, and further rulings are expected in the coming months.
segments.tr: La demanda subyacente que impugna la directiva de voto por correo continúa en los tribunales inferiores, y se esperan nuevos fallos en los próximos meses.

segments.src: In the meantime, election officials and voters in affected jurisdictions are being advised to watch for updated guidance from their local election offices and the Postal Service as mail ballots begin going out for the midterm cycle.
segments.tr: Mientras tanto, se aconseja a los funcionarios electorales y a los votantes en las jurisdicciones afectadas que estén atentos a las orientaciones actualizadas de sus oficinas electorales locales y del Servicio Postal a medida que las papeletas por correo comiencen a enviarse para el ciclo de mitad de mandato.

segments.src: As with any active litigation, the legal landscape here could shift again before Election Day, and readers should look to official state election websites and verified USPS communications for the most current, ballot-specific instructions.
segments.tr: Como ocurre con cualquier litigio activo, el panorama legal aquí podría cambiar nuevamente antes del Día de las Elecciones, y los lectores deben consultar los sitios web oficiales de elecciones estatales y las comunicaciones verificadas de USPS para obtener las instrucciones más actualizadas y específicas sobre las papeletas.

ar.title: قاضٍ واحد، وإلغاء واحد: كيف مهدت المحكمة العليا الطريق لقاعدة إدارة ترامب بشأن الاقتراع عبر البريد قبل أيام من بدء التصويت

segments.src: A federal judge in Boston has undone her own order blocking a Trump administration directive on how mail-in ballots are handled by the U.S.
segments.tr: ألغت قاضية فيدرالية في بوسطن أمرها الخاص الذي كان يمنع توجيهًا لإدارة ترامب بشأن كيفية التعامل مع بطاقات الاقتراع عبر البريد من قبل

segments.src: Postal Service, after the Supreme Court intervened in the case earlier this week.
segments.tr: هيئة البريد الأمريكية، وذلك بعد تدخل المحكمة العليا في القضية في وقت سابق من هذا الأسبوع.

segments.src: The reversal removes, at least for now, a legal obstacle standing between the administration's policy and the first wave of mail ballots set to go out for this year's midterm elections.
segments.tr: يزيل هذا الإلغاء، على الأقل في الوقت الحالي، عقبة قانونية كانت تقف بين سياسة الإدارة والموجة الأولى من بطاقات الاقتراع عبر البريد المقرر إرسالها لانتخابات التجديد النصفي لهذا العام.

segments.src: ## What the Original Order Required
segments.tr: ## ما الذي تطلبه الأمر الأصلي

segments.src: According to court filings, the directive at the center of the dispute instructs the Postal Service to apply barcoded tracking to mail-ballot envelopes and to share certain voter-list information with federal authorities as part of an effort the administration has described as strengthening the security and traceability of mail voting.
segments.tr: وفقًا لوثائق المحكمة، يوجه التوجيه الذي يقع في قلب النزاع هيئة البريد بتطبيق تتبع الرموز الشريطية (بار كود) على مظاريف بطاقات الاقتراع عبر البريد ومشاركة معلومات معينة عن قوائم الناخبين مع السلطات الفيدرالية كجزء من جهد وصفته الإدارة بأنه يعزز أمن وتتبع التصويت عبر البريد.

segments.src: Administration officials have said the measures are intended to reduce processing errors and give election offices a clearer chain of custody for ballots moving through the mail system.
segments.tr: قال مسؤولو الإدارة إن الإجراءات تهدف إلى تقليل أخطاء المعالجة ومنح مكاتب الانتخابات سلسلة عهدة أوضح للبطاقات التي تتحرك عبر نظام البريد.

segments.src: Voting rights groups and several state election officials sued to block the policy soon after it was announced, arguing it was rolled out without the standard rulemaking process and could create confusion or delays for voters relying on mail ballots.
segments.tr: رفعت مجموعات حقوق التصويت والعديد من مسؤولي الانتخابات في الولايات دعوى قضائية لمنع السياسة بعد وقت قصير من الإعلان عنها، بحجة أنها طُبقت دون عملية وضع القواعد القياسية ويمكن أن تخلق ارتباكًا أو تأخيرًا للناخبين الذين يعتمدون على بطاقات الاقتراع عبر البريد.

segments.src: The Boston-based judge sided with the challengers earlier this year and issued a nationwide injunction pausing the directive while the case proceeded.
segments.tr: انحازت القاضية التي تتخذ من بوسطن مقرًا لها إلى الطاعنين في وقت سابق من هذا العام وأصدرت أمرًا قضائيًا على مستوى البلاد بوقف التوجيه أثناء سير القضية.

segments.src: ## The Supreme Court's Role
segments.tr: ## دور المحكمة العليا

segments.src: The administration appealed, and the case moved through the courts on an emergency basis.
segments.tr: استأنفت الإدارة الحكم، وتحركت القضية عبر المحاكم على أساس طارئ.

segments.src: Earlier this week, the Supreme Court issued an order in the case that, according to legal analysts tracking the litigation, effectively required the lower court to lift its injunction while the underlying legal questions continue to be litigated.
segments.tr: في وقت سابق من هذا الأسبوع، أصدرت المحكمة العليا أمرًا في القضية، وفقًا للمحللين القانونيين الذين يتابعون التقاضي، يتطلب فعليًا من المحكمة الأدنى رفع أمرها القضائي بينما تستمر المسائل القانونية الأساسية في التقاضي.

segments.src: The justices did not rule on the merits of the policy itself; the order addressed only whether the injunction should remain in place during the appeal.
segments.tr: لم يحكم القضاة في مزايا السياسة نفسها؛ تناول الأمر فقط ما إذا كان يجب أن يظل الأمر القضائي ساريًا أثناء الاستئناف.

segments.src: Following that order, the district judge in Boston formally vacated her own injunction, writing that she was bound by the higher court's directive even as she noted the underlying legal challenge remains active.
segments.tr: بعد ذلك الأمر، ألغت قاضية المقاطعة في بوسطن رسميًا أمرها القضائي، كاتبة أنها ملزمة بتوجيه المحكمة الأعلى حتى مع ملاحظتها أن التحدي القانوني الأساسي لا يزال نشطًا.

segments.src: Legal experts caution that this procedural sequence is common in emergency litigation and does not amount to a final judgment on whether the policy is lawful.
segments.tr: يحذر الخبراء القانونيون من أن هذا التسلسل الإجرائي شائع في التقاضي الطارئ ولا يرقى إلى حكم نهائي بشأن ما إذا كانت السياسة قانونية.

segments.src: ## Practical Effect Ahead of the Midterms
segments.tr: ## التأثير العملي قبل انتخابات التجديد النصفي

segments.src: With the injunction lifted, the Postal Service and participating election offices are expected to move forward with barcoded ballot-envelope tracking and the data-sharing arrangements described in the directive, according to officials familiar with the rollout.
segments.tr: مع رفع الأمر القضائي، من المتوقع أن تمضي هيئة البريد ومكاتب الانتخابات المشاركة قدمًا في تتبع مظاريف بطاقات الاقتراع بالرموز الشريطية وترتيبات مشاركة البيانات الموضحة في التوجيه، وفقًا لمسؤولين مطلعين على التنفيذ.

segments.src: Because mail ballots for several midterm contests are scheduled to begin going out in the coming days, the timing has drawn significant attention from election administrators trying to determine how the change affects existing procedures.
segments.tr: نظرًا لأن بطاقات الاقتراع عبر البريد للعديد من منافسات التجديد النصفي من المقرر أن تبدأ في الصدور في الأيام المقبلة، فقد جذب التوقيت اهتمامًا كبيرًا من مسؤولي الانتخابات الذين يحاولون تحديد كيفية تأثير التغيير على الإجراءات الحالية.

segments.src: Some state election officials have said they are still reviewing guidance from the Postal Service on implementation and have asked for clarity on timelines.
segments.tr: قال بعض مسؤولي الانتخابات في الولايات إنهم ما زالوا يراجعون التوجيهات من هيئة البريد بشأن التنفيذ وطلبوا توضيحًا بشأن الجداول الزمنية.

segments.src: Voting rights organizations that brought the original suit said they plan to continue pressing their case in the lower courts, arguing that questions about the policy's legal basis and its effect on voters remain unresolved.
segments.tr: قالت منظمات حقوق التصويت التي رفعت الدعوى الأصلية إنها تخطط لمواصلة الضغط في قضيتها في المحاكم الأدنى، بحجة أن الأسئلة حول الأساس القانوني للسياسة وتأثيرها على الناخبين لا تزال دون حل.

segments.src: ## Reactions Remain Divided
segments.tr: ## ردود الفعل لا تزال منقسمة

segments.src: Administration officials welcomed the Supreme Court's order, framing it as validation of the government's authority to set mail-handling standards for ballots in coordination with the Postal Service.
segments.tr: رحب مسؤولو الإدارة بأمر المحكمة العليا، واصفين إياه بأنه تأكيد لسلطة الحكومة في وضع معايير التعامل مع بطاقات الاقتراع عبر البريد بالتنسيق مع هيئة البريد.

segments.src: Critics of the policy, including several election law scholars, have said the fight is far from over and that the Supreme Court's action was procedural rather than a ruling on the policy's merits.
segments.tr: قال منتقدو السياسة، بمن فيهم العديد من علماء قانون الانتخابات، إن المعركة لم تنته بعد وأن إجراء المحكمة العليا كان إجرائيًا وليس حكمًا على مزايا السياسة.

segments.src: Election administrators in multiple states, meanwhile, have generally struck a more cautious tone, emphasizing that their priority is ensuring voters are not confused or disenfranchised by any last-minute operational changes.
segments.tr: في غضون ذلك، اتخذ مسؤولو الانتخابات في ولايات متعددة نبرة أكثر حذرًا بشكل عام، مؤكدين أن أولويتهم هي ضمان عدم ارتباك الناخبين أو حرمانهم من حقوقهم بسبب أي تغييرات تشغيلية في اللحظة الأخيرة.

segments.src: Several have called for clear, timely communication from federal agencies as ballots begin to move through the mail.
segments.tr: دعا العديد منهم إلى تواصل واضح وفي الوقت المناسب من الوكالات الفيدرالية مع بدء تحرك بطاقات الاقتراع عبر البريد.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## ماذا يحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: The underlying lawsuit challenging the mail-ballot directive continues in the lower courts, and further rulings are expected in the coming months.
segments.tr: تستمر الدعوى القضائية الأساسية التي تتحدى توجيه الاقتراع عبر البريد في المحاكم الأدنى، ومن المتوقع صدور أحكام أخرى في الأشهر المقبلة.

segments.src: In the meantime, election officials and voters in affected jurisdictions are being advised to watch for updated guidance from their local election offices and the Postal Service as mail ballots begin going out for the midterm cycle.
segments.tr: في غضون ذلك، يُنصح مسؤولو الانتخابات والناخبون في الولايات القضائية المتضررة بمراقبة التوجيهات المحدثة من مكاتب الانتخابات المحلية وهيئة البريد مع بدء خروج بطاقات الاقتراع عبر البريد لدورة التجديد النصفي.

segments.src: As with any active litigation, the legal landscape here could shift again before Election Day, and readers should look to official state election websites and verified USPS communications for the most current, ballot-specific instructions.
segments.tr: كما هو الحال مع أي تقاضٍ نشط، يمكن أن يتغير المشهد القانوني هنا مرة أخرى قبل يوم الانتخابات، ويجب على القراء الرجوع إلى مواقع الانتخابات الرسمية للولايات واتصالات USPS الموثقة للحصول على أحدث التعليمات الخاصة ببطاقات الاقتراع.

fr.title: Un juge, un revirement : comment la Cour suprême a ouvert la voie à la règle de l'administration Trump sur les bulletins de vote par correspondance quelques jours avant le début du vote

segments.src: A federal judge in Boston has undone her own order blocking a Trump administration directive on how mail-in ballots are handled by the U.S.
segments.tr: Un juge fédéral de Boston est revenu sur sa propre ordonnance bloquant une directive de l'administration Trump sur la gestion des bulletins de vote par correspondance par le U.S.

segments.src: Postal Service, after the Supreme Court intervened in the case earlier this week.
segments.tr: Postal Service, après l'intervention de la Cour suprême dans l'affaire au début de la semaine.

segments.src: The reversal removes, at least for now, a legal obstacle standing between the administration's policy and the first wave of mail ballots set to go out for this year's midterm elections.
segments.tr: Ce revirement supprime, du moins pour l'instant, un obstacle juridique se dressant entre la politique de l'administration et la première vague de bulletins de vote par correspondance prêts à être envoyés pour les élections de mi-mandat de cette année.

segments.src: ## What the Original Order Required
segments.tr: ## Ce que prévoyait l'ordonnance initiale

segments.src: According to court filings, the directive at the center of the dispute instructs the Postal Service to apply barcoded tracking to mail-ballot envelopes and to share certain voter-list information with federal authorities as part of an effort the administration has described as strengthening the security and traceability of mail voting.
segments.tr: Selon les documents judiciaires, la directive au centre du litige enjoint au Postal Service d'appliquer un suivi par code-barres aux enveloppes de vote par correspondance et de partager certaines informations sur les listes électorales avec les autorités fédérales dans le cadre d'un effort que l'administration a décrit comme visant à renforcer la sécurité et la traçabilité du vote par correspondance.

segments.src: Administration officials have said the measures are intended to reduce processing errors and give election offices a clearer chain of custody for ballots moving through the mail system.
segments.tr: Des responsables de l'administration ont déclaré que ces mesures visaient à réduire les erreurs de traitement et à donner aux bureaux électoraux une chaîne de contrôle plus claire pour les bulletins transitant par le système postal.

segments.src: Voting rights groups and several state election officials sued to block the policy soon after it was announced, arguing it was rolled out without the standard rulemaking process and could create confusion or delays for voters relying on mail ballots.
segments.tr: Des groupes de défense du droit de vote et plusieurs responsables électoraux d'États ont intenté une action en justice pour bloquer la politique peu de temps après son annoncer, arguant qu'elle avait été mise en place sans la procédure réglementaire standard et pouvait créer de la confusion ou des retards pour les électeurs recourant au vote par correspondance.

segments.src: The Boston-based judge sided with the challengers earlier this year and issued a nationwide injunction pausing the directive while the case proceeded.
segments.tr: Le juge siégeant à Boston a donné raison aux plaignants au début de cette année et a prononcé une injonction nationale suspendant la directive pendant que l'affaire suivait son cours.

segments.src: ## The Supreme Court's Role
segments.tr: ## Le rôle de la Cour suprême

segments.src: The administration appealed, and the case moved through the courts on an emergency basis.
segments.tr: L'administration a fait appel, et l'affaire a progressé devant les tribunaux selon une procédure d'urgence.

segments.src: Earlier this week, the Supreme Court issued an order in the case that, according to legal analysts tracking the litigation, effectively required the lower court to lift its injunction while the underlying legal questions continue to be litigated.
segments.tr: Au début de la semaine, la Cour suprême a rendu une ordonnance dans cette affaire qui, selon les analystes juridiques suivant le contentieux, obligeait effectivement la juridiction inférieure à lever son injonction pendant que les questions juridiques sous-jacentes continuent d'être plaidées.

segments.src: The justices did not rule on the merits of the policy itself; the order addressed only whether the injunction should remain in place during the appeal.
segments.tr: Les juges ne se sont pas prononcés sur le fond de la politique elle-même ; l'ordonnance portait uniquement sur le point de savoir si l'injonction devait rester en vigueur pendant l'appel.

segments.src: Following that order, the district judge in Boston formally vacated her own injunction, writing that she was bound by the higher court's directive even as she noted the underlying legal challenge remains active.
segments.tr: À la suite de cette ordonnance, le juge de district à Boston a officiellement annulé sa propre injonction, écrivant qu'il était lié par la directive de la juridiction supérieure tout en notant que la contestation juridique sous-jacente reste active.

segments.src: Legal experts caution that this procedural sequence is common in emergency litigation and does not amount to a final judgment on whether the policy is lawful.
segments.tr: Des experts juridiques avertissent que cette séquence procédurale est courante dans les contentieux d'urgence et ne constitue pas un jugement définitif sur la légalité de la politique.

segments.src: ## Practical Effect Ahead of the Midterms
segments.tr: ## Effet pratique à l'approche des élections de mi-mandat

segments.src: With the injunction lifted, the Postal Service and participating election offices are expected to move forward with barcoded ballot-envelope tracking and the data-sharing arrangements described in the directive, according to officials familiar with the rollout.
segments.tr: Avec la levée de l'injonction, le Postal Service et les bureaux électoraux participants devraient aller de l'avant avec le suivi des enveloppes de vote par code-barres et les accords de partage de données décrits dans la directive, selon des responsables familiers avec le déploiement.

segments.src: Because mail ballots for several midterm contests are scheduled to begin going out in the coming days, the timing has drawn significant attention from election administrators trying to determine how the change affects existing procedures.
segments.tr: Étant donné que les bulletins de vote par correspondance pour plusieurs scrutins de mi-mandat doivent commencer à être envoyés dans les jours à venir, le calendrier a attiré une attention considérable de la part des administrateurs électoraux essayant de déterminer comment ce changement affecte les procédures existantes.

segments.src: Some state election officials have said they are still reviewing guidance from the Postal Service on implementation and have asked for clarity on timelines.
segments.tr: Certains responsables électoraux d'États ont déclaré qu'ils examinaient toujours les directives du Postal Service concernant la mise en œuvre et avaient demandé des éclaircissements sur les calendriers.

segments.src: Voting rights organizations that brought the original suit said they plan to continue pressing their case in the lower courts, arguing that questions about the policy's legal basis and its effect on voters remain unresolved.
segments.tr: Les organisations de défense du droit de vote à l'origine du recours initial ont déclaré qu'elles prévoyaient de continuer à faire valoir leur cause devant les tribunaux inférieurs, arguant que les questions concernant le fondement juridique de la politique et son effet sur les électeurs restent non résolues.

segments.src: ## Reactions Remain Divided
segments.tr: ## Les réactions restent divisées

segments.src: Administration officials welcomed the Supreme Court's order, framing it as validation of the government's authority to set mail-handling standards for ballots in coordination with the Postal Service.
segments.tr: Des responsables de l'administration ont salué l'ordonnance de la Cour suprême, la présentant comme une validation de l'autorité du gouvernement à fixer des normes de traitement du courrier pour les bulletins de vote en coordination avec le Postal Service.

segments.src: Critics of the policy, including several election law scholars, have said the fight is far from over and that the Supreme Court's action was procedural rather than a ruling on the policy's merits.
segments.tr: Les critiques de la politique, y compris plusieurs spécialistes du droit électoral, ont affirmé que la bataille est loin d'être terminée et que l'action de la Cour suprême était d'ordre procédural plutôt qu'une décision sur le fond de la politique.

segments.src: Election administrators in multiple states, meanwhile, have generally struck a more cautious tone, emphasizing that their priority is ensuring voters are not confused or disenfranchised by any last-minute operational changes.
segments.tr: Les administrateurs électoraux de plusieurs États, quant à eux, ont généralement adopté un ton plus prudent, soulignant que leur priorité est de veiller à ce que les électeurs ne soient pas confus ou privés de leurs droits par des changements opérationnels de dernière minute.

segments.src: Several have called for clear, timely communication from federal agencies as ballots begin to move through the mail.
segments.tr: Plusieurs ont appelé à une communication claire et rapide de la part des agences fédérales à mesure que les bulletins commencent à circuler par la poste.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Que se passera-t-il ensuite

segments.src: The underlying lawsuit challenging the mail-ballot directive continues in the lower courts, and further rulings are expected in the coming months.
segments.tr: Le procès sous-jacent contestant la directive sur les bulletins de vote par correspondance se poursuit devant les tribunaux inférieurs, et d'autres décisions sont attendues dans les mois à venir.

segments.src: In the meantime, election officials and voters in affected jurisdictions are being advised to watch for updated guidance from their local election offices and the Postal Service as mail ballots begin going out for the midterm cycle.
segments.tr: Dans l'intervalle, il est conseillé aux responsables électoraux et aux électeurs des juridictions concernées de surveiller les directives actualisées de leurs bureaux électoraux locaux et du Postal Service à mesure que les bulletins de vote par correspondance commencent à être envoyés pour le cycle de mi-mandat.

segments.src: As with any active litigation, the legal landscape here could shift again before Election Day, and readers should look to official state election websites and verified USPS communications for the most current, ballot-specific instructions.
segments.tr: Comme pour tout contentieux actif, le paysage juridique ici pourrait changer à nouveau avant le jour du scrutin, et les lecteurs doivent consulter les sites Web officiels des élections des États et les communications vérifiées de l'USPS pour obtenir les instructions les plus récentes et spécifiques aux bulletins de vote.
