segments.src: The administration appealed, and the case moved through the courts on an emergency basis.
segments.tr: A administração recorreu, e o caso tramitou pelos tribunais em regime de urgência.

segments.src: Earlier this week, the Supreme Court issued an order in the case that, according to legal analysts tracking the litigation, effectively required the lower court to lift its injunction while the underlying legal questions continue to be litigated.
segments.tr: No início desta semana, a Suprema Corte emitiu uma ordem no caso que, de acordo com analistas jurídicos que acompanham o litígio, efetivamente exigiu que o tribunal inferior suspendesse sua liminar enquanto as questões jurídicas subjacentes continuam a ser litigadas.

segments.src: The justices did not rule on the merits of the policy itself; the order addressed only whether the injunction should remain in place during the appeal.
segments.tr: Os magistrados não julgaram o mérito da política em si; a ordem abordou apenas se a liminar deveria permanecer em vigor durante o recurso.

segments.src: Following that order, the district judge in Boston formally vacated her own injunction, writing that she was bound by the higher court's directive even as she noted the underlying legal challenge remains active.
segments.tr: Após essa ordem, o juiz distrital em Boston anulou formalmente sua própria liminar, escrevendo que estava vinculado à diretriz do tribunal superior, mesmo observando que o desafio jurídico subjacente permanece ativo.

segments.src: Legal experts caution that this procedural sequence is common in emergency litigation and does not amount to a final judgment on whether the policy is lawful.
segments.tr: Especialistas jurídicos alertam que essa sequência processual é comum em litígios de emergência e não equivale a um julgamento final sobre se a política é legal.

segments.src: ## Practical Effect Ahead of the Midterms
segments.tr: ## Efeito Prático Antes das Eleições de Meio de Mandato

segments.src: With the injunction lifted, the Postal Service and participating election offices are expected to move forward with barcoded ballot-envelope tracking and the data-sharing arrangements described in the directive, according to officials familiar with the rollout.
segments.tr: Com a liminar suspensa, espera-se que o Postal Service e os escritórios eleitorais participantes avancem com o rastreamento de envelopes de cédulas com código de barras e os acordos de compartilhamento de dados descritos na diretriz, de acordo com autoridades familiarizadas com o lançamento.

segments.src: Because mail ballots for several midterm contests are scheduled to begin going out in the coming days, the timing has drawn significant attention from election administrators trying to determine how the change affects existing procedures.
segments.tr: Como as cédulas postais para várias disputas de meio de mandato estão programadas para começar a ser enviadas nos próximos dias, o cronograma atraiu atenção significativa de administradores eleitorais que tentam determinar como a mudança afeta os procedimentos existentes.

segments.src: Some state election officials have said they are still reviewing guidance from the Postal Service on implementation and have asked for clarity on timelines.
segments.tr: Alguns oficiais eleitorais estaduais disseram que ainda estão revisando a orientação do Postal Service sobre a implementação e pediram clareza sobre os cronogramas.

segments.src: Voting rights organizations that brought the original suit said they plan to continue pressing their case in the lower courts, arguing that questions about the policy's legal basis and its effect on voters remain unresolved.
segments.tr: Organizações de direitos de voto que moveram o processo original disseram que planejam continuar pressionando seu caso nos tribunais inferiores, argumentando que as questões sobre a base legal da política e seu efeito sobre os eleitores permanecem não resolvidas.

segments.src: ## Reactions Remain Divided
segments.tr: ## Reações Permanece Divididas

segments.src: Administration officials welcomed the Supreme Court's order, framing it as validation of the government's authority to set mail-handling standards for ballots in coordination with the Postal Service.
segments.tr: Funcionários da administração receberam bem a ordem da Suprema Corte, enquadrando-a como validação da autoridade do governo para definir padrões de manuseio de correio para cédulas em coordenação com o Postal Service.

segments.src: Critics of the policy, including several election law scholars, have said the fight is far from over and that the Supreme Court's action was procedural rather than a ruling on the policy's merits.
segments.tr: Críticos da política, incluindo vários acadêmicos de direito eleitoral, disseram que a luta está longe de terminar e que a ação da Suprema Corte foi processual e não uma decisão sobre o mérito da política.

segments.src: Election administrators in multiple states, meanwhile, have generally struck a more cautious tone, emphasizing that their priority is ensuring voters are not confused or disenfranchised by any last-minute operational changes.
segments.tr: Administradores eleitorais em vários estados, por sua vez, geralmente adotaram um tom mais cauteloso, enfatizando que sua prioridade é garantir que os eleitores não fiquem confusos ou disenfranchised por quaisquer mudanças operacionais de última hora.

segments.src: Several have called for clear, timely communication from federal agencies as ballots begin to move through the mail.
segments.tr: Vários pediram comunicação clara e oportuna de agências federais à medida que as cédulas começam a se mover pelo correio.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## O Que Acontece a Seguir

segments.src: The underlying lawsuit challenging the mail-ballot directive continues in the lower courts, and further rulings are expected in the coming months.
segments.tr: A ação judicial subjacente que contesta a diretriz de voto por correio continua nos tribunais inferiores, e novas decisões são esperadas nos próximos meses.

segments.src: In the meantime, election officials and voters in affected jurisdictions are being advised to watch for updated guidance from their local election offices and the Postal Service as mail ballots begin going out for the midterm cycle.
segments.tr: Enquanto isso, oficiais eleitorais e eleitores em jurisdições afetadas são aconselhados a ficar atentos a orientações atualizadas de seus escritórios eleitorais locais e do Postal Service à medida que as cédulas postais começam a ser enviadas para o ciclo de meio de mandato.

segments.src: As with any active litigation, the legal landscape here could shift again before Election Day, and readers should look to official state election websites and verified USPS communications for the most current, ballot-specific instructions.
segments.tr: Como em qualquer litígio ativo, o cenário jurídico aqui pode mudar novamente antes do Dia da Eleição, e os leitores devem procurar sites oficiais de eleições estaduais e comunicações verificadas do USPS para obter as instruções mais atuais e específicas para as cédulas.

in.title: Satu Hakim, Satu Pembatalan: Bagaimana Mahkamah Agung Membuka Jalan bagi Aturan Surat Suara Pos Pemerintahan Trump Beberapa Hari Sebelum Pemungutan Suara Dimulai

segments.src: A federal judge in Boston has undone her own order blocking a Trump administration directive on how mail-in ballots are handled by the U.S.
segments.tr: Seorang hakim federal di Boston telah mencabut perintahnya sendiri yang memblokir arahan pemerintahan Trump mengenai penanganan surat suara pos oleh U.S.

segments.src: Postal Service, after the Supreme Court intervened in the case earlier this week.
segments.tr: Postal Service, setelah Mahkamah Agung turun tangan dalam kasus tersebut awal minggu ini.

segments.src: The reversal removes, at least for now, a legal obstacle standing between the administration's policy and the first wave of mail ballots set to go out for this year's midterm elections.
segments.tr: Pembatalan tersebut menghapus, setidaknya untuk saat ini, hambatan hukum yang menghalangi antara kebijakan pemerintahan tersebut dan gelombang pertama surat suara pos yang akan dikirimkan untuk pemilihan paruh waktu tahun ini.

segments.src: ## What the Original Order Required
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Diisyaratkan oleh Perintah Asli

segments.src: According to court filings, the directive at the center of the dispute instructs the Postal Service to apply barcoded tracking to mail-ballot envelopes and to share certain voter-list information with federal authorities as part of an effort the administration has described as strengthening the security and traceability of mail voting.
segments.tr: Menurut dokumen pengadilan, arahan yang menjadi pusat perselisihan tersebut menginstruksikan Postal Service untuk menerapkan pelacakan barcode pada amplop surat suara pos dan untuk membagikan informasi daftar pemilih tertentu kepada otoritas federal sebagai bagian dari upaya yang digambarkan oleh pemerintah sebagai penguatan keamanan dan ketertelusuran pemungutan suara melalui pos.

segments.src: Administration officials have said the measures are intended to reduce processing errors and give election offices a clearer chain of custody for ballots moving through the mail system.
segments.tr: Para pejabat pemerintah telah mengatakan bahwa langkah-langkah tersebut dimaksudkan untuk mengurangi kesalahan pemrosesan dan memberikan kantor pemilihan rantai pengawasan yang lebih jelas untuk surat suara yang bergerak melalui sistem pos.

segments.src: Voting rights groups and several state election officials sued to block the policy soon after it was announced, arguing it was rolled out without the standard rulemaking process and could create confusion or delays for voters relying on mail ballots.
segments.tr: Kelompok hak suara dan beberapa pejabat pemilihan negara bagian menggugat untuk memblokir kebijakan tersebut tak lama setelah diumumkan, dengan alasan bahwa kebijakan itu diluncurkan tanpa proses pembuatan aturan standar dan dapat menciptakan kebingungan atau keterlambatan bagi pemilih yang mengandalkan surat suara pos.

segments.src: The Boston-based judge sided with the challengers earlier this year and issued a nationwide injunction pausing the directive while the case proceeded.
segments.tr: Hakim yang berbasis di Boston tersebut memihak para penantang awal tahun ini dan mengeluarkan perintah injunksi nasional yang menangguhkan arahan tersebut sementara kasus tersebut berjalan.

segments.src: ## The Supreme Court's Role
segments.tr: ## Peran Mahkamah Agung

segments.src: The administration appealed, and the case moved through the courts on an emergency basis.
segments.tr: Pemerintah mengajukan banding, dan kasus tersebut bergerak melalui pengadilan secara darurat.

segments.src: Earlier this week, the Supreme Court issued an order in the case that, according to legal analysts tracking the litigation, effectively required the lower court to lift its injunction while the underlying legal questions continue to be litigated.
segments.tr: Awal minggu ini, Mahkamah Agung mengeluarkan perintah dalam kasus tersebut yang, menurut para analis hukum yang memantau litigasi tersebut, secara efektif mengharuskan pengadilan lebih rendah untuk mencabut injunsinya sementara pertanyaan hukum yang mendasar terus disengketakan.

segments.src: The justices did not rule on the merits of the policy itself; the order addressed only whether the injunction should remain in place during the appeal.
segments.tr: Para hakim tidak memutuskan pokok perkara dari kebijakan itu sendiri; perintah tersebut hanya membahas apakah injunksi harus tetap berlaku selama banding.

segments.src: Following that order, the district judge in Boston formally vacated her own injunction, writing that she was bound by the higher court's directive even as she noted the underlying legal challenge remains active.
segments.tr: Menyusul perintah tersebut, hakim distrik di Boston secara resmi membatalkan injunksinya sendiri, menulis bahwa ia terikat oleh arahan pengadilan yang lebih tinggi bahkan saat ia mencatat bahwa tantangan hukum yang mendasar tetap aktif.

segments.src: Legal experts caution that this procedural sequence is common in emergency litigation and does not amount to a final judgment on whether the policy is lawful.
segments.tr: Para ahli hukum memperingatkan bahwa urutan prosedural ini biasa terjadi dalam litigasi darurat dan tidak sama dengan putusan akhir tentang apakah kebijakan tersebut sah.

segments.src: ## Practical Effect Ahead of the Midterms
segments.tr: ## Efek Praktis Menjelang Pemilu Paruh Waktu

segments.src: With the injunction lifted, the Postal Service and participating election offices are expected to move forward with barcoded ballot-envelope tracking and the data-sharing arrangements described in the directive, according to officials familiar with the rollout.
segments.tr: Dengan dicabutnya injunksi tersebut, Postal Service dan kantor pemilihan yang berpartisipasi diharapkan untuk maju dengan pelacakan amplop surat suara barcode dan pengaturan pembagian data yang dijelaskan dalam arahan tersebut, menurut para pejabat yang akrab dengan peluncuran tersebut.

segments.src: Because mail ballots for several midterm contests are scheduled to begin going out in the coming days, the timing has drawn significant attention from election administrators trying to determine how the change affects existing procedures.
segments.tr: Karena surat suara pos untuk beberapa kontes paruh waktu dijadwalkan mulai dikirimkan dalam beberapa hari mendatang, waktunya telah menarik perhatian signifikan dari para administrator pemilihan yang mencoba menentukan bagaimana perubahan tersebut mempengaruhi prosedur yang ada.

segments.src: Some state election officials have said they are still reviewing guidance from the Postal Service on implementation and have asked for clarity on timelines.
segments.tr: Beberapa pejabat pemilihan negara bagian mengatakan mereka masih meninjau panduan dari Postal Service tentang implementasi dan telah meminta kejelasan tentang jadwal.

segments.src: Voting rights organizations that brought the original suit said they plan to continue pressing their case in the lower courts, arguing that questions about the policy's legal basis and its effect on voters remain unresolved.
segments.tr: Organisasi hak suara yang mengajukan gugatan awal mengatakan mereka berencana untuk terus mendesak kasus mereka di pengadilan yang lebih rendah, dengan alasan bahwa pertanyaan tentang dasar hukum kebijakan dan efeknya pada pemilih tetap belum terselesaikan.

segments.src: ## Reactions Remain Divided
segments.tr: ## Reaksi Tetap Terbelah

segments.src: Administration officials welcomed the Supreme Court's order, framing it as validation of the government's authority to set mail-handling standards for ballots in coordination with the Postal Service.
segments.tr: Para pejabat pemerintah menyambut baik perintah Mahkamah Agung, membingkainya sebagai validasi kewenangan pemerintah untuk menetapkan standar penanganan surat untuk surat suara berkoordinasi dengan Postal Service.

segments.src: Critics of the policy, including several election law scholars, have said the fight is far from over and that the Supreme Court's action was procedural rather than a ruling on the policy's merits.
segments.tr: Kritikus kebijakan tersebut, termasuk beberapa sarjana hukum pemilihan, telah mengatakan bahwa pertarungan ini jauh dari selesai dan bahwa tindakan Mahkamah Agung bersifat prosedural daripada putusan atas pokok kebijakan.

segments.src: Election administrators in multiple states, meanwhile, have generally struck a more cautious tone, emphasizing that their priority is ensuring voters are not confused or disenfranchised by any last-minute operational changes.
segments.tr: Para administrator pemilihan di berbagai negara bagian, sementara itu, umumnya mengambil nada yang lebih hati-hati, menekankan bahwa prioritas mereka adalah memastikan pemilih tidak bingung atau dicabut hak pilihnya oleh perubahan operasional menit-menit terakhir.

segments.src: Several have called for clear, timely communication from federal agencies as ballots begin to move through the mail.
segments.tr: Beberapa telah menyerukan komunikasi yang jelas dan tepat waktu dari lembaga federal ketika surat suara mulai bergerak melalui pos.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Selanjutnya

segments.src: The underlying lawsuit challenging the mail-ballot directive continues in the lower courts, and further rulings are expected in the coming months.
segments.tr: Gugatan hukum yang mendasari yang menantang arahan surat suara pos berlanjut di pengadilan yang lebih rendah, dan putusan lebih lanjut diharapkan dalam beberapa bulan mendatang.

segments.src: In the meantime, election officials and voters in affected jurisdictions are being advised to watch for updated guidance from their local election offices and the Postal Service as mail ballots begin going out for the midterm cycle.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, para pejabat pemilihan dan pemilih di yurisdiksi yang terkena dampak disarankan untuk memantau panduan yang diperbarui dari kantor pemilihan lokal mereka dan Postal Service saat surat suara pos mulai dikirimkan untuk siklus paruh waktu.

segments.src: As with any active litigation, the legal landscape here could shift again before Election Day, and readers should look to official state election websites and verified USPS communications for the most current, ballot-specific instructions.
segments.tr: Seperti halnya litigasi aktif apa pun, lanskap hukum di sini dapat bergeser lagi sebelum Hari Pemilu, dan pembaca harus melihat situs web pemilihan negara bagian resmi dan komunikasi USPS yang diverifikasi untuk instruksi khusus surat suara yang paling mutakhir.

ja.title: 1人の判事、1つの覆滅：最高裁が投票開始の数日前にトランプ政権の郵便投票規則への道を開いた経緯

segments.src: A federal judge in Boston has undone her own order blocking a Trump administration directive on how mail-in ballots are handled by the U.S.
segments.tr: ボストンの連邦判事は、今週初めに最高裁判所がこの訴訟に介入したことを受け、米国郵政公社（U.S.

segments.src: Postal Service, after the Supreme Court intervened in the case earlier this week.
segments.tr: Postal Service）による郵便投票の取り扱いに関するトランプ政権の指示を差し止める自らの命令を覆した。

segments.src: The reversal removes, at least for now, a legal obstacle standing between the administration's policy and the first wave of mail ballots set to go out for this year's midterm elections.
segments.tr: この覆滅により、少なくとも現時点では、政権の政策と、今年の期中間選挙に向けて発送される予定の第1波の郵便投票との間に立ちはだかる法的障害が取り除かれることになる。

segments.src: ## What the Original Order Required
segments.tr: ## 当初の命令が求めていた内容

segments.src: According to court filings, the directive at the center of the dispute instructs the Postal Service to apply barcoded tracking to mail-ballot envelopes and to share certain voter-list information with federal authorities as part of an effort the administration has described as strengthening the security and traceability of mail voting.
segments.tr: 裁判所の提出書類によると、争点となっている指示は、郵政公社に対し、郵便投票の封筒にバーコードによる追跡を適用し、特定の有権者名簿情報を連邦当局と共有するよう命じるものであり、政権側はこれを郵便投票の安全性と追跡可能性を強化するための取り組みと説明している。

segments.src: Administration officials have said the measures are intended to reduce processing errors and give election offices a clearer chain of custody for ballots moving through the mail system.
segments.tr: 政権高官らは、これらの措置は処理エラーを減らし、選挙管理事務所に対して郵便システムを通過する投票用紙のより明確な保管連鎖（chain of custody）を提供することを目的としていると述べている。

segments.src: Voting rights groups and several state election officials sued to block the policy soon after it was announced, arguing it was rolled out without the standard rulemaking process and could create confusion or delays for voters relying on mail ballots.
segments.tr: 投票権擁護団体や複数の州の選挙管理当局は、この政策が発表された直後に、標準的な規則制定プロセスを経ずに導入され、郵便投票に頼る有権者に混乱や遅延をもたらす可能性があると主張して、政策の差し止めを求めて提訴した。

segments.src: The Boston-based judge sided with the challengers earlier this year and issued a nationwide injunction pausing the directive while the case proceeded.
segments.tr: ボストンを拠点とする判事は今年初め、原告側に賛同し、訴訟が進行する間、この指示を一時停止する全国的な差し止め命令を下した。

segments.src: ## The Supreme Court's Role
segments.tr: ## 最高裁判所の役割

segments.src: The administration appealed, and the case moved through the courts on an emergency basis.
segments.tr: 政権側は控訴し、訴訟は緊急案件として裁判所を通過した。

segments.src: Earlier this week, the Supreme Court issued an order in the case that, according to legal analysts tracking the litigation, effectively required the lower court to lift its injunction while the underlying legal questions continue to be litigated.
segments.tr: 今週初め、最高裁はこの訴訟において命令を下した。この訴訟を追跡している法分析家らによると、この命令は実質的に、根本的な法的問題の訴訟が継続している間、下級審に対して差し止め命令を解除することを求めるものであった。

segments.src: The justices did not rule on the merits of the policy itself; the order addressed only whether the injunction should remain in place during the appeal.
segments.tr: 最高裁判事らは政策自体の是非については判断を下しておらず、命令は控訴期間中に差し止め命令を維持すべきか否かのみを扱った。

segments.src: Following that order, the district judge in Boston formally vacated her own injunction, writing that she was bound by the higher court's directive even as she noted the underlying legal challenge remains active.
segments.tr: その命令を受けて、ボストンの連邦地裁判事は自らの差し止め命令を正式に無効とし、根本的な法的異議申し立ては依然として有効であると指摘しつつも、上級審の指示に拘束されると記した。

segments.src: Legal experts caution that this procedural sequence is common in emergency litigation and does not amount to a final judgment on whether the policy is lawful.
segments.tr: 法専門家らは、この手続き上の順序は緊急訴訟において一般的であり、政策が合法であるか否かについての最終的な判決を意味するものではないと警告している。

segments.src: ## Practical Effect Ahead of the Midterms
segments.tr: ## 中間選挙を控えた実質的な影響

segments.src: With the injunction lifted, the Postal Service and participating election offices are expected to move forward with barcoded ballot-envelope tracking and the data-sharing arrangements described in the directive, according to officials familiar with the rollout.
segments.tr: 差し止め命令が解除されたことで、導入に詳しい関係者によると、郵政公社と参加する選挙管理事務所は、指示に記載されているバーコード付き投票用封筒の追跡とデータ共有の取り決めを進める見通しである。

segments.src: Because mail ballots for several midterm contests are scheduled to begin going out in the coming days, the timing has drawn significant attention from election administrators trying to determine how the change affects existing procedures.
segments.tr: いくつかの中間選挙の郵便投票が数日以内に発送され始める予定であるため、このタイミングは、この変更が既存の手続きにどのように影響するかを判断しようとする選挙管理者の大きな注目を集めている。

segments.src: Some state election officials have said they are still reviewing guidance from the Postal Service on implementation and have asked for clarity on timelines.
segments.tr: 一部の州の選挙管理当局は、実施に関する郵政公社からのガイダンスをまだ検討中であり、スケジュールについての明確化を求めていると述べている。

segments.src: Voting rights organizations that brought the original suit said they plan to continue pressing their case in the lower courts, arguing that questions about the policy's legal basis and its effect on voters remain unresolved.
segments.tr: 当初の訴訟を提起した投票権擁護団体は、政策の法的根拠や有権者への影響に関する疑問は未解決のままであると主張し、下級審で訴訟を継続する意向を表明した。

segments.src: ## Reactions Remain Divided
segments.tr: ## 反応は依然として二分

segments.src: Administration officials welcomed the Supreme Court's order, framing it as validation of the government's authority to set mail-handling standards for ballots in coordination with the Postal Service.
segments.tr: 政権高官らは最高裁の命令を歓迎し、郵政公社と連携して投票用紙の郵便取り扱い基準を設定する政府の権限が認められたものと位置づけた。

segments.src: Critics of the policy, including several election law scholars, have said the fight is far from over and that the Supreme Court's action was procedural rather than a ruling on the policy's merits.
segments.tr: 複数の選挙法学者を含むこの政策の批判者らは、戦いはまだ終わっておらず、最高裁の行動は手続き上のものに過ぎず、政策の是非に関する判決ではないと述べている。

segments.src: Election administrators in multiple states, meanwhile, have generally struck a more cautious tone, emphasizing that their priority is ensuring voters are not confused or disenfranchised by any last-minute operational changes.
segments.tr: 一方、複数の州の選挙管理者は概してより慎重な姿勢を示しており、最優先事項は、直前の運用変更によって有権者が混乱したり、投票権を奪われたりしないようにすることだと強調している。

segments.src: Several have called for clear, timely communication from federal agencies as ballots begin to move through the mail.
segments.tr: 複数の管理者が、投票用紙が郵便で移動し始めるにあたり、連邦機関からの明確かつタイムリーな連絡を求めている。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 今後の展開

segments.src: The underlying lawsuit challenging the mail-ballot directive continues in the lower courts, and further rulings are expected in the coming months.
segments.tr: 郵便投票の指示に異議を唱える根本的な訴訟は下級審で継続しており、今後数ヶ月以内に追加の判決が下される見通しである。

segments.src: In the meantime, election officials and voters in affected jurisdictions are being advised to watch for updated guidance from their local election offices and the Postal Service as mail ballots begin going out for the midterm cycle.

segments.src: As with any active litigation, the legal landscape here could shift again before Election Day, and readers should look to official state election websites and verified USPS communications for the most current, ballot-specific instructions.
segments.tr: 現在進行中の訴訟と同様に、ここでの法的状況は投票日前に再び変化する可能性があり、読者は最も最新の投票固有の指示について、公式の州選挙ウェブサイトや確認済みの USPS の連絡を参照する必要がある。

de.title: Ein Richter, eine Aufhebung: Wie der Oberste Gerichtshof den Weg für die Briefwahl-Regelung der Trump-Regierung wenige Tage vor Beginn der Abstimmung freimachte

segments.src: A federal judge in Boston has undone her own order blocking a Trump administration directive on how mail-in ballots are handled by the U.S.
segments.tr: Eine Bundesrichterin in Boston hat ihre eigene Anordnung aufgehoben, mit der sie eine Richtlinie der Trump-Regierung zur Handhabung von Briefwahlunterlagen durch den U.S.

segments.src: Postal Service, after the Supreme Court intervened in the case earlier this week.
segments.tr: Postal Service blockiert hatte, nachdem der Oberste Gerichtshof Anfang dieser Woche in den Fall eingegriffen hatte.

segments.src: The reversal removes, at least for now, a legal obstacle standing between the administration's policy and the first wave of mail ballots set to go out for this year's midterm elections.
segments.tr: Die Aufhebung beseitigt, zumindest vorerst, ein rechtliches Hindernis zwischen der Politik der Regierung und der ersten Welle von Briefwahlunterlagen, die für die diesjährigen Zwischenwahlen verschickt werden sollen.

segments.src: ## What the Original Order Required
segments.tr: ## Was die ursprüngliche Anordnung erforderte

segments.src: According to court filings, the directive at the center of the dispute instructs the Postal Service to apply barcoded tracking to mail-ballot envelopes and to share certain voter-list information with federal authorities as part of an effort the administration has described as strengthening the security and traceability of mail voting.
segments.tr: Gerichtsunterlagen zufolge weist die Richtlinie, die im Mittelpunkt des Streits steht, den Postal Service an, eine Strichcode-Nachverfolgung für Briefwahlumschläge anzuwenden und bestimmte Informationen über Wählerlisten mit Bundesbehörden zu teilen, als Teil einer Bemühung, die die Regierung als Stärkung der Sicherheit und Rückverfolgbarkeit der Briefwahl beschrieben hat.

segments.src: Administration officials have said the measures are intended to reduce processing errors and give election offices a clearer chain of custody for ballots moving through the mail system.
segments.tr: Vertreter der Regierung haben erklärt, dass die Maßnahmen dazu dienen sollen, Verarbeitungsfehler zu reduzieren und Wahlämtern eine klarere Nachweiskette für Stimmzettel zu geben, die durch das Postsystem befördert werden.

segments.src: Voting rights groups and several state election officials sued to block the policy soon after it was announced, arguing it was rolled out without the standard rulemaking process and could create confusion or delays for voters relying on mail ballots.
segments.tr: Gruppen für Wahlrechte und mehrere staatliche Wahlleiter klagten kurz nach der Ankündigung gegen die Politik und argumentierten, dass sie ohne das übliche Regelsetzungsverfahren eingeführt wurde und zu Verwirrung oder Verzögerungen für Wähler führen könnte, die auf Briefwahl angewiesen sind.

segments.src: The Boston-based judge sided with the challengers earlier this year and issued a nationwide injunction pausing the directive while the case proceeded.
segments.tr: Die in Boston ansässige Richterin gab den Klägern Anfang des Jahres recht und erließ eine landesweite einstweilige Verfügung, die die Richtlinie während des laufenden Verfahrens aussetzte.

segments.src: ## The Supreme Court's Role
segments.tr: ## Die Rolle des Obersten Gerichtshofs

segments.src: The administration appealed, and the case moved through the courts on an emergency basis.
segments.tr: Die Regierung legte Berufung ein, und der Fall wurde im Eilverfahren durch die Gerichte verhandelt.

segments.src: Earlier this week, the Supreme Court issued an order in the case that, according to legal analysts tracking the litigation, effectively required the lower court to lift its injunction while the underlying legal questions continue to be litigated.
segments.tr: Anfang dieser Woche erließ der Oberste Gerichtshof eine Anordnung in dem Fall, die laut Rechtsexperten, die den Rechtsstreit verfolgen, das untere Gericht effektiv dazu zwang, seine einstweilige Verfügung aufzuheben, während die zugrunde liegenden Rechtsfragen weiterhin verhandelt werden.

segments.src: The justices did not rule on the merits of the policy itself; the order addressed only whether the injunction should remain in place during the appeal.
segments.tr: Die Richter entschieden nicht über die inhaltliche Rechtmäßigkeit der Politik selbst; die Anordnung befasste sich lediglich mit der Frage, ob die einstweilige Verfügung während der Berufung in Kraft bleiben sollte.

segments.src: Following that order, the district judge in Boston formally vacated her own injunction, writing that she was bound by the higher court's directive even as she noted the underlying legal challenge remains active.
segments.tr: Nach dieser Anordnung hob die Bezirksrichterin in Boston ihre eigene einstweilige Verfügung formell auf und schrieb, dass sie an die Anweisung des höheren Gerichts gebunden sei, auch wenn sie anmerkte, dass die zugrunde liegende rechtliche Anfechtung weiterhin aktiv sei.

segments.src: Legal experts caution that this procedural sequence is common in emergency litigation and does not amount to a final judgment on whether the policy is lawful.
segments.tr: Rechtsexperten warnen, dass dieser verfahrensrechtliche Ablauf bei Eilverfahren üblich ist und kein endgültiges Urteil darüber darstellt, ob die Politik rechtmäßig ist.

segments.src: ## Practical Effect Ahead of the Midterms
segments.tr: ## Praktische Auswirkungen vor den Zwischenwahlen

segments.src: With the injunction lifted, the Postal Service and participating election offices are expected to move forward with barcoded ballot-envelope tracking and the data-sharing arrangements described in the directive, according to officials familiar with the rollout.
segments.tr: Mit der Aufhebung der einstweiligen Verfügung wird erwartet, dass der Postal Service und die teilnehmenden Wahlämter mit der Strichcode-Nachverfolgung von Wahlumschlägen und den in der Richtlinie beschriebenen Datenaustauschvereinbarungen fortfahren, so mit der Einführung vertraute Beamte.

segments.src: Because mail ballots for several midterm contests are scheduled to begin going out in the coming days, the timing has drawn significant attention from election administrators trying to determine how the change affects existing procedures.
segments.tr: Da die Briefwahlunterlagen für mehrere Zwischenwahlen in den kommenden Tagen verschickt werden sollen, hat der Zeitpunkt erhebliche Aufmerksamkeit bei Wahlleitern erregt, die versuchen festzustellen, wie sich die Änderung auf bestehende Verfahren auswirkt.

segments.src: Some state election officials have said they are still reviewing guidance from the Postal Service on implementation and have asked for clarity on timelines.
segments.tr: Einige staatliche Wahlleiter haben erklärt, dass sie die Anweisungen des Postal Service zur Umsetzung noch prüfen und um Klarheit bezüglich der Zeitpläne gebeten haben.

segments.src: Voting rights organizations that brought the original suit said they plan to continue pressing their case in the lower courts, arguing that questions about the policy's legal basis and its effect on voters remain unresolved.
segments.tr: Organisationen für Wahlrechte, die die ursprüngliche Klage eingereicht hatten, erklärten, sie planten, ihren Fall in den unteren Gerichten weiter voranzutreiben, mit dem Argument, dass Fragen zur rechtlichen Grundlage der Politik und deren Auswirkungen auf die Wähler weiterhin ungeklärt seien.

segments.src: ## Reactions Remain Divided
segments.tr: ## Die Reaktionen bleiben gespalten

segments.src: Administration officials welcomed the Supreme Court's order, framing it as validation of the government's authority to set mail-handling standards for ballots in coordination with the Postal Service.
segments.tr: Regierungsvertreter begrüßten die Anordnung des Obersten Gerichtshofs und werteten sie als Bestätigung der Befugnis der Regierung, in Abstimmung mit dem Postal Service Standards für die Handhabung von Briefwahlunterlagen festzulegen.

segments.src: Critics of the policy, including several election law scholars, have said the fight is far from over and that the Supreme Court's action was procedural rather than a ruling on the policy's merits.
segments.tr: Kritiker der Politik, darunter mehrere Experten für Wahlrecht, sagten, der Kampf sei noch lange nicht vorbei und die Aktion des Obersten Gerichtshofs sei verfahrensrechtlicher Natur gewesen und kein Urteil über die inhaltliche Rechtmäßigkeit der Politik.

segments.src: Election administrators in multiple states, meanwhile, have generally struck a more cautious tone, emphasizing that their priority is ensuring voters are not confused or disenfranchised by any last-minute operational changes.
segments.tr: Wahlleiter in mehreren Bundesstaaten haben unterdessen im Allgemeinen einen vorsichtigeren Ton angeschlagen und betont, dass ihre Priorität darin bestehe, sicherzustellen, dass Wähler nicht durch kurzfristige betriebliche Änderungen verwirrt oder von der Wahl ausgeschlossen werden.

segments.src: Several have called for clear, timely communication from federal agencies as ballots begin to move through the mail.
segments.tr: Mehrere haben eine klare, zeitnahe Kommunikation von Bundesbehörden gefordert, während die Stimmzettel beginnen, durch die Post befördert zu werden.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Was passiert als Nächstes

segments.src: The underlying lawsuit challenging the mail-ballot directive continues in the lower courts, and further rulings are expected in the coming months.
segments.tr: Die zugrunde liegende Klage gegen die Briefwahl-Richtlinie wird in den unteren Gerichten fortgesetzt, und weitere Urteile werden in den kommenden Monaten erwartet.

segments.src: In the meantime, election officials and voters in affected jurisdictions are being advised to watch for updated guidance from their local election offices and the Postal Service as mail ballots begin going out for the midterm cycle.
segments.tr: In der Zwischenzeit wird Wahlleitern und Wählern in den betroffenen Zuständigkeitsbereichen geraten, auf aktualisierte Anleitungen ihrer lokalen Wahlämter und des Postal Service zu achten, während die Briefwahlunterlagen für den Zyklus der Zwischenwahlen verschickt werden.

segments.src: As with any active litigation, the legal landscape here could shift again before Election Day, and readers should look to official state election websites and verified USPS communications for the most current, ballot-specific instructions.
segments.tr: Wie bei jedem laufenden Rechtsstreit könnte sich die rechtliche Lage hier vor dem Wahltag noch einmal ändern, und Leser sollten sich auf den offiziellen Wahl-Websites der Bundesstaaten und bei verifizierten USPS-Mitteilungen über die aktuellsten, wahlbezogenen Anweisungen informieren.

segments.src: The Boston-based judge sided with the challengers earlier this year and issued a nationwide injunction pausing the directive while the case proceeded.

segments.src: ## The Supreme Court's Role

segments.tr: Chính quyền đã kháng cáo, và vụ án được đưa qua các tòa án theo cơ sở khẩn cấp.

segments.tr: Đầu tuần này, Tối Cao Pháp Vụ đã ban hành lệnh trong vụ án mà theo các nhà phân tích pháp lý theo dõi vụ kiện, trên thực tế yêu cầu tòa án cấp dưới dỡ bỏ lệnh cấm trong khi các câu hỏi pháp lý cơ bản tiếp tục được tranh tụng.

segments.src: The justices did not rule on the merits of the policy itself; the order addressed only whether the injunction should remain in place during the appeal.
segments.tr: Các thẩm phán đã không đưa ra phán quyết về bản chất của chính sách; lệnh chỉ giải quyết vấn đề liệu lệnh cấm có nên được duy trì trong thời gian kháng cáo hay không.

segments.src: Following that order, the district judge in Boston formally vacated her own injunction, writing that she was bound by the higher court's directive even as she noted the underlying legal challenge remains active.

segments.src: Legal experts caution that this procedural sequence is common in emergency litigation and does not amount to a final judgment on whether the policy is lawful.
segments.tr: Các chuyên gia pháp lý cảnh báo rằng trình tự thủ tục này là phổ biến trong các vụ kiện tụng khẩn cấp và không cấu thành một phán quyết cuối cùng về việc liệu chính sách đó có hợp pháp hay không.

segments.src: ## Practical Effect Ahead of the Midterms
segments.tr: ## Tác Động Thực Tế Trước Kỳ Bầu Cử Giữa Nhiệm Kỳ

segments.src: With the injunction lifted, the Postal Service and participating election offices are expected to move forward with barcoded ballot-envelope tracking and the data-sharing arrangements described in the directive, according to officials familiar with the rollout.
segments.tr: Với lệnh cấm được dỡ bỏ, Bưu điện và các văn phòng bầu cử tham gia dự kiến sẽ tiến hành theo dõi phong bì phiếu bầu bằng mã vạch và các thỏa thuận chia sẻ dữ liệu được mô tả trong chỉ thị, theo các quan chức quen thuộc với việc triển khai.

segments.src: Because mail ballots for several midterm contests are scheduled to begin going out in the coming days, the timing has drawn significant attention from election administrators trying to determine how the change affects existing procedures.
segments.tr: Do phiếu bầu qua thư cho một số cuộc đua giữa nhiệm kỳ dự kiến bắt đầu được gửi đi trong những ngày tới, thời gian đã thu hút sự chú ý đáng kể từ các nhà quản lý bầu cử đang cố gắng xác định cách thay đổi ảnh hưởng đến các thủ tục hiện hành.

segments.src: Some state election officials have said they are still reviewing guidance from the Postal Service on implementation and have asked for clarity on timelines.
segments.tr: Một số quan chức bầu cử tiểu bang cho biết họ vẫn đang xem xét hướng dẫn từ Bưu điện về việc thực hiện và đã yêu cầu làm rõ về mốc thời gian.

segments.src: Voting rights organizations that brought the original suit said they plan to continue pressing their case in the lower courts, arguing that questions about the policy's legal basis and its effect on voters remain unresolved.
segments.tr: Các tổ chức quyền lợi cử tri đã đệ đơn kiện ban đầu cho biết họ có kế hoạch tiếp tục thúc đẩy vụ án của mình tại các tòa án cấp dưới, lập luận rằng các câu hỏi về cơ sở pháp lý của chính sách và ảnh hưởng của nó đối với cử tri vẫn chưa được giải quyết.

segments.src: ## Reactions Remain Divided
segments.tr: ## Phản Ứng Vẫn Chia rẽ

segments.src: Administration officials welcomed the Supreme Court's order, framing it as validation of the government's authority to set mail-handling standards for ballots in coordination with the Postal Service.
segments.tr: Các quan chức chính quyền hoan nghênh lệnh của Tối Cao Pháp Vụ, coi đó là sự xác nhận thẩm quyền của chính phủ trong việc thiết lập các tiêu chuẩn xử lý thư cho các lá phiếu phối hợp với Bưu điện.

segments.src: Critics of the policy, including several election law scholars, have said the fight is far from over and that the Supreme Court's action was procedural rather than a ruling on the policy's merits.
segments.tr: Những người chỉ trích chính sách này, bao gồm một số học giả luật bầu cử, cho biết cuộc chiến còn lâu mới kết thúc và hành động của Tối Cao Pháp Vụ mang tính thủ tục hơn là phán quyết về bản chất của chính sách.

segments.src: Election administrators in multiple states, meanwhile, have generally struck a more cautious tone, emphasizing that their priority is ensuring voters are not confused or disenfranchised by any last-minute operational changes.
segments.tr: Trong khi đó, các nhà quản lý bầu cử ở nhiều tiểu bang thường giữ giọng điệu thận trọng hơn, nhấn mạnh rằng ưu tiên của họ là đảm bảo cử tri không bị bối rối hoặc tước quyền bởi bất kỳ thay đổi hoạt động nào vào phút chót.

segments.src: Several have called for clear, timely communication from federal agencies as ballots begin to move through the mail.
segments.tr: Một số người đã kêu gọi giao tiếp rõ ràng, kịp thời từ các cơ quan liên bang khi các lá phiếu bắt đầu di chuyển qua đường bưu điện.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Điều Gì Sẽ Xảy Ra Tiếp Theo

segments.src: The underlying lawsuit challenging the mail-ballot directive continues in the lower courts, and further rulings are expected in the coming months.
segments.tr: Vụ kiện cơ bản thách thức chỉ thị phiếu bầu qua thư tiếp tục diễn ra ở các tòa án cấp dưới, và các phán quyết tiếp theo dự kiến sẽ có trong những tháng tới.

segments.src: In the meantime, election officials and voters in affected jurisdictions are being advised to watch for updated guidance from their local election offices and the Postal Service as mail ballots begin going out for the midterm cycle.
segments.tr: Trong thời gian này, các quan chức bầu cử và cử tri ở các khu vực tài phán bị ảnh hưởng được khuyến nghị theo dõi các hướng dẫn cập nhật từ các văn phòng bầu cử địa phương và Bưu điện khi các phiếu bầu qua thư bắt đầu được gửi đi cho chu kỳ giữa nhiệm kỳ.

segments.src: As with any active litigation, the legal landscape here could shift again before Election Day, and readers should look to official state election websites and verified USPS communications for the most current, ballot-specific instructions.
segments.tr: Như với bất kỳ vụ kiện tụng đang diễn ra nào, bối cảnh pháp lý ở đây có thể thay đổi một lần nữa trước Ngày Bầu Cử, và độc giả nên tìm đến các trang web bầu cử chính thức của tiểu bang và thông tin liên lạc được xác minh của USPS để có các hướng dẫn cụ thể về lá phiếu mới nhất.
